primary_answer_detail: Separating destination endpoint drivers increased NBSR median throughput by 25.746803832891096 percent from one to two groups; every two-group repeat exceeded every one-group repeat.
strict_stable_limitation: No NBSR cell met the pre-existing CV <= 5 percent repeatability gate after five repeats where required.
delta_limitation: The large Direct/NBSR deltas are measured for this run but are not generalized because several cells remained above the 5 percent CV gate.
limiting_resource: The tracked benchmark processes consumed about 3.73 to 3.75 effective cores within the four-logical-processor 0x55 affinity pool at two and four NBSR groups. Four groups reduced throughput and increased p99. This is an affinity-constrained benchmark CPU limit, not a whole-host, NIC, memory, or production NBSR ceiling.
